name: Article 26, § 5 – 364
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council on the Union Civil Protection Mechanism and Union support for health emergency preparedness and response, and repealing Decision No 1313/2013/EU (Union Civil Protection Mechanism)
part_text: 5. Member States shall designate contact points for the functioning of the Hub and inform the Commission accordingly. Those contact points shall be the same contact points designated by the Member States for the ERCC in accordance with Article 25(5).
